NL Pitcher of the Month Goes to Cabrera 
The premier pitcher this past month in the National League was <Edward Cabrera:player#1623> of the <Chicago Cubs:team#6>. He was one mighty tough pitcher, finishing April with a sensational 5-0 record and a 1.42 ERA.

The Cubs star made 6 starts and surrendered 19 hits in 31.2 innings. He struck out 30 and walked 10.
